name: mephistopheles4
description: Ayman Diab's agent skills, as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: grimoire
plugins.description: A spellbook of agent skills for AI. Cast wisely. head-chef leads a brigade of sessions from one Claude Desktop chat, contract turns agreed terms into a skill or agent, eagle-eye lays out coupled decisions, and groundtrack draws a plan as a call graph.

plugins.name: incantation
plugins.description: A voice pair-programming partner for Claude Code, through Voicebox. /incantation listens at all times, says each request back before it acts, and speaks only when something needs you. Needs Voicebox and ffmpeg on the same machine.
